newsitem.title: USA: Salomon CEO paid salary of $1 mln for 1995.
newsitem.headline: Salomon CEO paid salary of $1 mln for 1995.

text.p: Robert Denham, chairman and chief executive officer of Salomon Inc, was paid a salary of $1.0 million, the same as in the previous two years, the company said on Friday.

In a proxy filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Salomon said it also paid Denham $858,847 worth of restricted common shares awarded under the long-term stock program for 1996. He received no award in 1995.
Salomon granted Dehnam an additional 1996 bonus of $875,000, the payment of which is required to be deferred in order to preserve the company's compensation deduction under the U.S. tax code.
For 1995, Denham received additional compensation of $9,963. The company did not provide any information regarding its 1995 financial status.
